citation: 'Nordström, Kusk, Vänersborg' ('Nordström, coachman, Vänersborg'). Glass negative by K & A Vikner, Vänersborg, 1903. Vänersborgs museum, VMVP3391.
author: K & A Vikner (photographers, Vänersborg)
repository: Vänersborgs museum, Vänersborg, Sweden, VMVP3391 (K-samsök http://kulturarvsdata.se/vbg/photo/VMVP3391; DigitaltMuseum 021015684767). Image server copy 1515 x 2362 px (WebP), saved here as JPEG at the same size.
locator: The whole negative; a full-length standing portrait. His face, frontal, is at x 635-820, y 520-700 (about 180 px across, cap brim to chin).
rights_note: K-samsök (the Swedish heritage aggregator, record built 2026-11) gives the image licence as Public Domain Mark 1.0 ('pdmark'). Europeana's older copy of the record gives CC BY-SA 4.0 instead; the museum's current feed is taken as authoritative here, and the conflict is recorded. A studio photograph made in 1903 is out of protection under Swedish law (simple photographic pictures made before 1969).
access_notes: Found 2026-11-07 through the K-samsök search API (text=kusk), which gives the year 1903 and the studio. Image fetched from ems.dimu.org at dimension=4000x4000, which returned 1515 x 2362. digitaltmuseum.se answered 403. The same studio's 'Andersson, Kusk, Vänersborg' (VMVP01061, undated) shows a younger man in a cap and work jacket. A sharper but undated alternative: 'Kusken Karlsson', Ernst Blom, Västmanlands läns museum Vlm-Blom P 158 (2097 x 3000; face about 190 px), a young coachman with a whip.
note: THIS IS NOT AUGUST BILLINGS. No photograph of August Billings was found. Nordström stands in for him because he was a Swedish coachman (the record's title says so) photographed in 1903, the year before the scene, and by appearance a young man of about August Billings's age in 1904 (29; born January 1875 in Sweden, came to the US 1892; enumerated as 'Helper' in the Glessners' rear building, 1900 census). The record gives no first name and no age: the age is a reading of the picture. He is a coachman in livery, a step above a stable helper. A studio glass-negative portrait of a man standing before a painted lakeside backdrop in a long pale double-breasted livery greatcoat with dark collar and cuffs, a peaked cap with a pale band and an embroidered monogram badge, hands behind his back. His face is frontal and sharp: dark eyes, straight brows, a broad straight nose, a neat dark moustache turned up at the ends, a short square chin, prominent ears. Spots and emulsion loss at the corners of the plate, none on the face.
what_it_supplies: the proportions of a young Swedish man's face in the scene's own year, frontal and sharp
a Swedish coachman's livery greatcoat and cap of 1903
what_it_does_not_supply: August Billings's face, his colouring, or anything about him
